latest.summary: OAuth refresh, batch night fixes, and calendar sharing on partner setup
changes: Refresh Google access tokens silently instead of forcing consent on every reconnect
Remove non-functional close button from proposal rules warning banner
Fix batch sleeping room conflicts using local calendar dates (no more off-by-one day errors)
Allow clearing and retyping Number of Nights on batch proposals
Share household Google Calendar when adding or activating partners with a Gmail address
